item.title: Apache Polaris vs Lakekeeper vs Gravitino in 2026: Which Iceberg Catalog Should You Actually Run?
item.description: Your Iceberg tables are not the hard part anymore. Every engine speaks the format, and object storage is cheap. What breaks at 3am is the catalog: the thing that answers “where does this table live, who may read it, and which storage credential do I hand out?” Get that wrong and you end up with three engines writing to the same bucket under three different metadata pointers, and a data lake that quietly forks itself.
